name: SG15 current versus oracle region decisions on fixed VOC examples
sample_rule: first annotated manifest row for each of 20 VOC classes, selected before looking at outputs
partition: same canonical SPEC32 as full SG15
oracle_labelling: GT foreground fraction >= 0.5 in each annotation-resolution SPEC32 region
interpretation: GT-labelled majority oracle is a diagnostic upper bound for hard region decisions, not an inference method
no_selection: No class, image, prior, threshold or region rule is selected by the 20 example results
